summary: Implemented the M3.5 spec exactly as approved (r1): the f32_to_f16 builtin (5th Q4_0Builtin variant, OpFConvert f32->f16 RNE, Float16-only, no capability beyond the M3.3c-coopmat union M2.6-Q4_K_M-dequant union), the fused q4km_matmul_rb_coopmat.axc (per-workgroup Q4_K_M dequant -> shared[f16] -> M3.3c register-blocked coopmat K-loop, byte-identical M2.6 dequant + verbatim M3.3c structure), the f16-ACCUMULATOR-matched ggml CPU oracle with gate-K policy, the bit-within-tol GPU tests (AT-1770/1771), the honest multi-size TFLOPS bench + SAME-SHAPE A/B line (AT-1772/1774), the no-new-capability-beyond-union CI anchor (AT-1773), the f32_to_f16 layer + codegen unit coverage (AT-1775/1776), and the m34 --fused SAME-SHAPE A/B harness (script + emit.py). All non-GPU work is CI-green; the GPU-gated numbers were filled by the NVIDIA orchestrator run and emit.py was fixed so they REPRODUCE BY CONSTRUCTION. HONEST (measured): the fused kernel collapses M3.4's ~87,000x cross-shape gap to ~9x SAME-SHAPE (AXIOM 11.27 TFLOPS vs llama 101.48 TFLOPS) BUT this is NOT a usable-kernel win — at the A/B k=14336 AXIOM is NUMERICALLY INVALID (max_rel_diff=29.07, f16 accumulator overflows; correct only K<=256), so it is fast-but-WRONG at inference K; M3.5b needs an f32-accumulator coopmat. The n=1 GEMV (7.42) is cross-shape context only.

known_limitations: GPU-measured numbers (AT-1770/1771/1772/1774) require the NVIDIA orchestrator run; placeholders in DESIGN/BENCHMARKS.
Per-element dequant recomputes get_scale_min_k4 + d/dmin across a superblock's 16 tile_k K-blocks (OQ-3); scale-caching deferred to M3.5b per the spec (correctness-first).
The f16-accumulator within-tol result is NVIDIA-coopmat-accumulator-specific (documented); a strict-f16 vendor accumulator may differ.
